slots.jd.family-contractor.about:
About us and the job
Hollis and Sons Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor in Dayton, Ohio. The owners still work on the tools and know every customer by name. We are looking for an apprentice electrician to join our crew on site. You will work alongside a journeyman, learn the trade the right way, and help us finish jobs that we are proud to put our name on.
slots.jd.family-contractor.duties:
What the job involves
- Trace faults in circuits and equipment with a journeyman and help find the cause
- Read plans and blueprints to lay out runs, boxes and fixtures before work starts
- Install panels and connect circuits to them under supervision
- Mount and wire light fixtures, switches and outlets
- Keep the work area clean and safe, and put tools and materials away at the end of the day
- Ask questions and have your work checked before it is closed up
slots.jd.family-contractor.needs:
What you need
- Panel installation and fire alarm wiring experience
- Troubleshooting skills, including multimeter use
- Blueprint reading and a working knowledge of grounding and bonding
- 2 or more years of experience in electrical work
- Construction Safety Card, required
- Journeyman Electrician Licence, preferred
slots.r1.b1: Installs panels and fixtures guided by careful blueprint reading, reducing layout rework by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Runs conduit across job sites with safe power tool use for cutting, bending and fastening each run to plan.
slots.r1.b3: Pulls and terminates wire on motor controls work, lowering termination errors by 50 percent as checked by the journeyman.
slots.r1.b4: Traces faults in circuits through methodical multimeter use and reports findings to the journeyman before repairs begin.
slots.r1.i1: Works as an apprentice electrician at Summit Power Contractors, tracing faults in circuits and equipment under the guidance of a journeyman.
slots.r1.i2: Reads plans and blueprints at Summit Power Contractors to lay out and install electrical work as an apprentice electrician.
slots.summary.1: Apprentice electrician with about 2 years of experience working under a journeyman who checks each job. Brings troubleshooting, load calculations and code compliance skills to every task on site.
slots.summary.2: Apprentice-level electrical worker with about 2 years on site, carrying out tasks under a journeyman who reviews the finished work. Skills include troubleshooting, load calculations and code compliance, backed by an Apprenticeship Certificate in Electrical Construction.
